biggest_catch: The $50 is not free money: your friend (or you, as the referred user) must trade at least $100 of their own money on Gemini within 30 days — risking real capital and paying Gemini's trading fees, which eat into the reward. The reward is paid in crypto of your choice, and Gemini's own support page warns 'the value of cryptocurrencies can be volatile and the amount of cryptocurrency you receive as a reward may fluctuate depending on market conditions.' It is a referral marketing incentive, not income, and 'up to $50' is a maximum, not a guaranteed amount.
catches: 'Up to $50' is a maximum for users in Hong Kong, New Zealand, and the United States — the exact amount paid is not guaranteed at $50; reward amounts vary by jurisdiction.
Requires a referral link from an existing Gemini user — you cannot claim it by signing up directly; you need someone to refer you.

The referee must trade at least USD $100 within the first 30 days; deposits and withdrawals do not count — only revenue-generating trades (instant buy/sell/convert, OTC, Active Trader, derivatives where available).
Reward is processed only after the referral passes 32 days on Gemini, plus up to 2 days processing.
Recruit-tier referral rewards are capped at USD $1,500 total.

Referral program is currently eligible in only three jurisdictions per the support article: Hong Kong, New Zealand, United States (the older $15 blog listed more countries — that offer appears superseded).
Gemini may modify or cancel the referral program at any time; referral rewards may be taxable (US 1099-MISC threshold applies at $750 of platform income).

eligibility: Referral program currently eligible in Hong Kong, New Zealand, and the United States (per current support article); the referred friend must be a new Gemini signup via the referrer's unique link and trade at least USD $100 within the first 30 days. Reward amounts and trade requirements vary by jurisdiction.

steps: The existing Gemini user opens the Rewards hub (Account → Rewards on web, or the purple Rewards button in the app) and taps 'Share link' to copy their unique referral link.
The new user signs up for Gemini through that referral link (a direct signup without the link does not qualify).

The new user (referee) trades at least USD $100 in qualifying trades (instant buy/sell/convert, OTC, Active Trader, derivatives where available) within the first 30 days — deposits and withdrawals do not count.

After the referral passes 32 days on Gemini, both the referrer and the referee receive the reward (up to $50 for US users) in the crypto of their choice, within up to 2 days of processing; there is no time limit before you can sell the reward.
timing: Once a referral passes 32 days on Gemini and qualifies (minimum $100 trade), the reward is processed and made available to both parties; processing may take up to 2 days.
